elements_selected.content:
Extend build_static() in src/web/build.rs to emit search-index.json in the output directory root. Extract corpus statistics from the Tantivy index (or directly from the parsed files).

Schema per CON-013-004:
{
  'avgDl': <number>,             // average document length (total terms)
  'docs': [
    {
      'n': '<page_name>',        // page name
      's': '<slug>',             // URL slug
      'dl': <doc_length>,        // total terms in document
      'tf': { '<term>': <count>, ... }  // term frequency map
    }
  ],
  'df': { '<term>': <doc_count>, ... }  // document frequency per term
}

To generate term frequencies: tokenize each document's body text using the same tokenization as Tantivy (lowercase, split on whitespace/punctuation). Count term occurrences per document. Compute document frequency (number of documents containing each term). Compute average document length.

Short field names (n, s, dl, tf, df) minimize JSON size per NFR-013-006 (≤30% of vault text content).

The file is written to {out_dir}/search-index.json.

REQ-013-014, CON-013-004, ADR-013-004.
